birth.segment: The Notebook from the Lithographer's Floor
birth.stop: Antigua, Donostia, birth in the Gutenfelder house
birth.date_confidence: attested. Euskaltzaindia's official biography gives 27 September 1929; several agency obituaries printed 1927 and called him 84 at death, and that variant is not followed here. The Basque Wikipedia article supplies the street and house number (Amilibia, now Zumalakarregi, 579, the Gutenfelder house). The coordinate is the core of Antigua near Gaskuña plaza, not the house itself, which is not independently pinned.

stops.stop: Donostia, the cloth off another man's coffin
stops.date_confidence: attested that he was cremated on 15 January 2012 and that his coffin was covered with the ikurriña that had covered Txomin Iturbe Abasolo's (txillardegi.wordpress.com/biografia, orain.eus).
